alex_chu: Quick heads-up: weekly release orbit check today 16:00 UTC. We have a short embargo window 15:30 - 17:00 UTC for model and infra changes. Please avoid non-urgent deploys during that window.

maria_gonzalez: Thanks — is there a firm rollback threshold defined for canaries? e.g., p95 latency uplift > 20% or error rate > 0.5%?

jun_saito: Default thresholds: p95 +20%, p99 +30%, error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m. Canary size: 3% traffic for 10m, then 10m observation. If either threshold trips, auto-rollback.

olivia_reed: If someone needs an exception (security hotfix or compliance patch), ping me and @sre_oncall ASAP. We'll coordinate and document the exception window.

release-bot: :rotating_light: Release embargo scheduled by alex_chu for channel eng-releases. Embargo window: 2026-11-04T15:30:00Z -> 2026-11-04T17:00:00Z. Canary policy: standard-3pct-10m.

alex_chu: Quick note on monitoring: run the canary health query before cutover and after 1m, 5m, 10m. If you see any sustained increase, mark the canary as failed and halt rollout.

jun_saito: Example PromQL for our checks: ```
sum(rate(http_request_errors_total{job="inference"}[5m])) by (job) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[5m])) by (job)
``` use that for baseline vs canary.

sre_oncall: I'll be on standby during embargo. Pager rotations already adjusted. If you want me to mute noisy alerts, DM me the alert IDs.

maria_gonzalez: Also adding a note: if we hit cold-cache latency spikes, prefer reducing canary traffic rather than immediate rollback so we can gather traces. Mentioning triage leads: @jun_saito, @olivia_reed.

alex_chu: Perfect. After embargo we plan a quick follow-up post (15min after 17:00) with pass/fail and any action items. I'll post the short changelog there. :thumbsup:
